Name: SFX_BLOCK_RES_SHARE_PARAM
Description: Lets a map block use another map's SFX bundle. When a map block (or its LOD block) loads its effects (sfx/SfxBnd_mAA_BB_CC_DD.ffxbnd), the row ID is the block's map number written as a number (m12_34_56_78 → 12345678). If the row exists and Shared Map Number is above 0, that map's SFX bundle is loaded instead. Retail has only row 0 (no sharing).

Fields.Name: Shared Map Number
Fields.Description: Map whose SFX bundle this block loads instead of its own, written as a number (m12_34_56_78 → 12345678). 0: the block uses its own bundle.
